title: ESET discovers PromptLock, the first AI-powered ransomware
description: ESET Research discovers PromptLock, a new type of ransomware using GenAI to execute attacks.The malware runs a locally accessible AI language model to generate malicious Lua scripts in real time, which are compatible across Windows, Linux, and macOS.PromptLock uses a freely available language model accessed via an API, meaning the generated malicious scripts are served directly to the infected device.Based on predefined text prompts, PromptLock autonomously determines whether to exfiltrate or encrypt data.While ESET considers PromptLock a proof of concept, the threat it represents is very real. BRATISLAVA, Slovakia, Aug. 27, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- ESET researchers have uncovered a new type of ransomware that leverages generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) to execute attacks. description: China now turns off AI functions for the whole country during exam periods. The CCP knows that their youth is learning less when they use artificial intelligence. Meanwhile, American students are using AI as a crutch and missing out on valuable learning experiences as a result.
